title: Chemical analysis of the Red Pyramid staining

tellings.quote: Fast forward 5 years, we now have chemical analysis data that was taken of this staining on the walls of the Red Pyramid that conclusively proves it has absolutely nothing to do with bats.

plain: Chemical tests taken around 2022 of the staining on the walls of the Red Pyramid, a pyramid at Dahshur in Egypt, are said to prove conclusively that the stains have nothing to do with bats. Geoffrey Drumm, who says an alien showed him the true purpose of the pyramids, tells this on Michels's show without naming who did the tests, as support for his view that the pyramids had some other use.
